messages.リンバスのドンキホーテのE.G.O「一生シチュー」(TETH)。色欲資源を溜める: Don Quixote's TETH E.G.O Lifetime Stew: a 3-target Lust Blunt AoE whose damage grows with stored Lust resources and that raises Burn and Bleed Count; in practice it suits Bleed teams (assumes Threadspin Ⅴ). Skills, Threadspin changes, and Identity synergy.

messages.リンバスのドンキホーテのE.G.O「願いの石」(TETH)。出血回数・振動・麻痺: Don Quixote's TETH E.G.O Wishing Cairn: a Blunt E.G.O that applies Bleed Count, Tremor, and Paralyze together, likely a filler for teams where other TETH options do not fit. Skills, Threadspin changes, and Identity synergy.

messages.【リンバス】愛と憎悪の名の下に ドンキホーテのE.G.Oの性能と使い方｜Limb: In the Name of Love and Hate (Don Quixote E.G.O) | Skills and Guide | Limbus Assistant

Skills, Threadspin changes, and Identity synergy.
